scope: Audited current-round ADMIN pause/resume, fixed-calendar remaining SLA, native timer preservation, original-request idempotency, audit/inbox/webhook transactions

postgres.note: The later serialization-contract-only test was run on H2; the 8 core scenarios ran on PostgreSQL

redReproductions.cause: Readable nodes excluded suspended tasks; existing coverage only exercised active or finished tasks
redReproductions.fix: Retain suspended task read participation; mutation authorization still rejects suspension

redReproductions.cause: Contract required pausedAt although configured serialization omits absent null fields
redReproductions.fix: Mark pausedAt optional while validating actual read and write serialization

checks: Same original task, instance and submission round remain
Sub-minute precision, lunches, holidays, DST and repeated pauses
Current original calendar revision survives newer calendar publication
Native timers retain original due and do not execute while suspended
Both notification failure paths roll back engine, due times, app versions, audit and outbox
Application-first lock and post-lock reminder recheck, with deterministic concurrent transaction barriers
Role, tenant, round, version, original idempotency key and unsafe input boundaries
Parallel countersign deadlines and no-deadline tasks
After resume only actual human decision approves
remaining: Application-detail control UI and client original-request recovery
Actual HTTP response contract, browser confirmation/cancel, narrow viewport
In-flight runtime upgrade and restart preservation; financial occupancy acceptance
